Calculation Details

How it works

Calculate lumber board feet from thickness, width, length and quantity. Use the units shown in the calculator and review every assumption before using the result.

Formula

Board feet = thickness(in) × width(in) × length(ft) ÷ 12 × quantity.

Worked example

Ten boards measuring 1 × 8 × 10 ft total about 66.67 board feet.

Important assumptions

This tool is designed for planning and comparison. Real-world prices, manufacturer ratings, building requirements, lender terms, electrical codes, tolerances, and product specifications can vary.

Frequently asked questions

Are the results exact?
